_doc: Blog EN · How to Open a Pastry Shop (SPEC guia-pasteleria-en D19, 17-oct-2026). El id es el del CATÁLOGO
(products-catalog.ts), que con urlByLang.en pinta la landing EN /en/digital-products/how-to-open-a-pastry-shop y $69.
Posts: las cuatro librerías de prompts EN de panadería y pastelería (Bakery Consultant Pro, Pastry Consultant Pro,
Creative Pastry, Creative Bakery). Víctimas = SLUGS EN de la landing: se sacrifican el Restaurant Financial Plan Kit,
el Inventory Kit y el eBook de prompts; nunca el Food Cost Kit Pro, el HACCP Kit ni el Bakery Business Plan Kit,
que son las ventas cruzadas del propio producto (SPEC D17).

prompt-library-bakery-consulting.parrafo: If the bakery you're planning is your own, the startup prompts below work best with the numbers in front of you. The {ENLACE} walks through the decisions that come before opening day, from cottage food or a retail food permit to startup costs line by line, kitchen capacity and a 3-year plan, with eight Excel tools.

prompt-library-pastry-consulting.parrafo: Designing a pastry shop starts before the floor plan: whether the space can take a hood duct to the roof, how many square feet the production kitchen needs and what the build-out will really cost. The {ENLACE} covers those decisions with a site visit checklist and a startup cost calculator, before you sign a lease.

prompt-library-creative-pastry.parrafo: If your next step is a shop of your own, the {ENLACE} takes you from the idea to opening day: permits by state, startup costs, the production kitchen's equipment and the six peaks of the year, with eight Excel tools.

prompt-library-creative-bakery.parrafo: Running a production bakery is one job; opening one is another. The {ENLACE} covers the second: cottage food or a retail food permit, startup costs line by line, kitchen capacity, staff and a 3-year financial plan, with eight Excel tools.
